params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output ('HOST='+$env:COMPUTERNAME); foreach($n in @('codex','ollama','aider','python','node','git')){ $c=Get-Command $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($c){Write-Output ($n+'='+$c.Source)} else {Write-Output ($n+'=MISSING')} }; if(Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ Write-Output '--- OLLAMA LIST ---'; ollama list }; Write-Output '--- ACTIONS RUNNER SERVICES ---'; Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'actions.runner*' -or $_.DisplayName -like '*Actions Runner*' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status,StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '--- REPO ---'; $repo=Join-Path $HOME 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'; if(Test-Path $repo){ git -C $repo rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD; git -C $repo status --short } else { Write-Output ('repo-missing='+$repo) }
